name: Email (Resend and AgentMail)
description: Send email through Resend, and list, read and reply to AgentMail inboxes.

defaultFrom.title: Default sender
defaultFrom.description: Sender used by resend_send_email when a call gives no `from`, for example "Acme <hello@acme.com>". Its domain must be verified in Resend.

allowedRecipients.title: Allowed recipients
allowedRecipients.description: Addresses (user@example.com) or "@domain" rules that resend_send_email may send to (to, cc, bcc, reply_to). Empty (the default) means any address, as before. Agents cannot change this setting.

lockSender.title: Lock sender
lockSender.description: When true and a defaultFrom is configured, calls cannot override the `from` field. Default false.
